horizon_extension_contract.label_rule: QC observed Junggu at exact origin+horizon
horizon_extension_contract.eligibility_rule: finite nonnegative observed target AND same split AND2021-2024 study

graph_report.unmatched_hour_rule: skip unmatched geographical points; connect ordered nearest visits only within max_gap_hours
graph_report.assignment_rule: nearest horizontal candidate per hour, ties by station_key; PM values not consulted
graph_report.terminal_rule: append receptor KR:111121 as node 0 at age 0
graph_report.repeat_rule: each ordered pair counts at most once per trajectory
graph_report.weight_definition: number of training arrivals with ordered transition / all training arrivals
graph_report.interpretation: Seoul-arrival-conditional geographical co-passage order, not physical PM transport probability
